conformance.stage_2_api: sample green; UI suite needs a real browser (graded env)

global_rules: Money is conserved: every payment moves minor units from one balance to another; the service never creates or destroys money.
Amounts are integers (minor units), 1..1000000000. Floats, strings, 0 and negatives are 422 validation_failed.

Idempotency-Key is required on POST /payments, /requests, /requests/{id}/pay, /splits, /authorizations, /authorizations/{id}/capture, /payments/{id}/corrections, /payments/{id}/refunds, /correction-batches (missing -> 400 missing_idempotency_key; same key + different body -> 409 idempotency_key_reuse; same key + same body -> 200 replay of the original response). Scope is user+method+path+key.
Unknown query parameters are ignored, never an error. Bad limit/offset are 422.
Auth: Bearer token from POST /auth/login or /auth/signup. Bad/foreign token -> 401. Handles are case-sensitive; derived handle = local part of email, lowercased, non [a-z0-9] -> _.
Timestamps are RFC 3339 with offset. Balances are integers; no floats anywhere.
POST /_test/reset (204) and /_test/export (200) / /_test/import (204) exist for the harness. Reset validates the fixture strictly (422 on any violation).
minor_units defaults from currency (JPY 0, BHD 3, else 2) when the fixture omits it; /me exposes minor_units.
implementation: build/src/{server.js,ledger.js,ui.js}; staged copies in stage-1/ .. stage-4/ pinned by POCKETFUL_STAGE
notes: Zero npm dependencies; single-file Node http server; state is in-memory, synchronous under a promise-chain mutex so concurrent idempotent requests serialize.
Scrypt password hashing (N=16384) ~130ms per login on this VM.
Container: FROM node:24-alpine, COPY src/, ENV POCKETFUL_STAGE=N, CMD node src/server.js; listens on 0.0.0.0:$PORT (default 8080).

overshoot_gates.stage-1 image: serves 404 for every stage-2+ route (authorizations, UI pages, corrections, statement, refunds, batches, settlements)
overshoot_gates.stage-2 image: serves 404 for stage-3+ routes (corrections, statement, as_of, refunds, batches)
overshoot_gates.stage-3 image: serves 404 for stage-4 routes (refunds, correction-batches, settlements)

endpoints: POST /payments {to_handle,amount,note?,visibility?} -> 201 payment; insufficient -> 409 insufficient_funds; self -> 422 self_payment; unknown handle -> 404
GET /activity?limit&offset -> {payments:[payment...], has_more}; payment visible iff public, or caller is a party
GET /requests?limit&offset&direction=in|outgoing&status -> {requests, has_more}; visible to requester+payer only
POST /splits {amount,participant_handles[],note?} -> 201 {split_id,shares:[{handle,amount}],requests[]}; largest-remainder shares, remainder to first participants

adds: POST /authorizations {to_handle,amount,note?,visibility?} -> 201 authorization {authorization_id,amount,captured_amount:0,remaining_amount,status:open,expires_at}; holds amount from available
POST /authorizations/{id}/capture {amount} -> 201 payment (partial allowed, multiple captures); over-capture -> 422/409; capture on expired/voided -> 409
Authorizations expire after authorization_ttl_seconds (default 600); expiry releases the hold

Browser UI at /, /requests, /split, /authorizations, /signup, /login with the exact data-testid contract from stage-2.md §9 (form-key idempotency on the pay form, pay-uncertain on lost responses, latest-wins wallet refresh)

POST /payments/{id}/corrections {expected_revision,amount,effective_at,reason} -> 201 {payment_id,revision,amount,effective_at}; optimistic concurrency (stale expected_revision -> 409); correction must not overdraw any party at any instant (historical overdraft check) -> 409; reason required
GET /me?as_of=<instant> -> historical balance/available/held at that instant (+as_of echo, +known_at)
Original payment and original idempotent responses are immutable under correction
POST /payments/{id}/refunds {amount?,reason?} -> 201 linked payment with refund_of=<original>; partial refunds allowed; refund cannot exceed refundable amount -> 409
POST /correction-batches {corrections:[{payment_id,expected_revision,amount,effective_at,reason}]} (operator only) -> 201 {batch_id,results[]}; atomic per item, 403 for non-operators
settlement_operator_ids in the reset fixture designates operators
